rationale: fetch_skia_for_release.py and fetch_v8_for_release.py probe a stale download lock's owner through the shared process_liveness.pid_alive instead of os.kill(pid, 0), which on Windows sends Ctrl+C to the whole console. When the probe is unavailable (the script imported as a package, or copied without its sibling) it answers 'unknown', and an unknown owner is never judged stale, so the bounded wait still decides. The pinned revisions, the archives they resolve to, their digests and every unpacked layout are unchanged, so no Skia or V8 backend, render surface or captured output moves. Watch-only; no authority moves.
